speak.title: Role-play: filming at the restaurant
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A customer wants to film a video at one of your tables. Other guests are already eating. Ask what equipment they will use and how long it will take. You can say yes, no, or yes with rules.

b.text: You want to film a short video of your lunch. It could bring the restaurant new customers. Explain why it's good for the business and promise to be quiet.

phrases: Would it be all right if I filmed my meal?
I'm afraid other guests might feel uncomfortable.
It won't take long, and I'll keep the noise down.
I'd be happy to agree if you stay at your table.
That's not really fair on the other customers.
Could we agree on a time limit?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the manager say yes, and was it a fair decision?
